IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersionRollupPathFilterValue') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionRollupPathFilterValue] ( [AssetVersionRollupPathFilterUid] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, [Value] nvarchar(250) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_AssetVersionRollupPathFilterValue] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [AssetVersionRollupPathFilterUid] ASC, [Value] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK__MetricAssetVersionRollupPathFilterValue_MetricAssetVersionRollupPathFilter') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionRollupPathFilterValue] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK__MetricAssetVersionRollupPathFilterValue_MetricAssetVersionRollupPathFilter] FOREIGN KEY([AssetVersionRollupPathFilterUid]) REFERENCES [metrics].[AssetVersionRollupPathFilter] ([Uid]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionRollupPathFilterValue] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK__MetricAssetVersionRollupPathFilterValue_MetricAssetVersionRollupPathFilter]; END
